title: 250 YEARS OF CELEBRATION 400 YEARS OF SWEAT EQUITY (PT 2)

sense.text:
“There appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun.” This woman is the nation of Israel, the twelve tribes. The Lord likened the children of Israel to a comely and delicate woman, so that is the woman spoken of here.

“Clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet.” The commandment is a lamp and the law is light: that is the sun and the moon spoken of here, and that light was given only to the Israelites. He gave his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

“Upon her head a crown of twelve stars”: the twelve stars are the twelve tribes of Israel. That is what this woman, the nation of Israel, is all about.

“And she being with child cried, travailing in birth.” The woman, the twelve tribes, was trying to give birth: we were trying to get Christ born to save us from the hand of the Romans that ruled over us, because the Romans had taken the kingdom of Israel by force.

“Pained to be delivered” means we were persecuted. We were trying to bring Christ forth and keep him from being killed like so many of our other sons were being killed.

“There appeared another wonder in heaven”: in our heaven, our kingdom. What came into our rulership? “A great red dragon”: the white man. The Romans are the red people that came into our heaven and took our kingdom by force.

“Having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.” The seven heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain, and the seven crowns are seven different rulers among this beast. The eighth head was not there yet at this time; it came in later, when the deadly wound of Revelation 13:3 was healed.

“His tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven.” The stars of heaven are the twelve tribes of Israel, and the third part is Judah, Benjamin and Levi, the tribes left in Jerusalem, with stragglers of the other tribes among them, like the sister named Anna, who was of the tribe of Asher. So nobody can throw you off by saying three tribes is not a third: other tribes were mingled in there as well.

The history is this. Assyria conquered the northern kingdom and held it captive. Then Babylon rose up and took down Assyria, and so took Assyria’s captives, the northern kingdom; then Babylon moved into the southern kingdom and took Judah. When Cyrus came in, he allowed all of the tribes to go back and build. By the time Rome came, the bulk of the tribes had already gone, coming to the Americas, and only those left in Jerusalem were under Rome.

“And did cast them to the earth”: put them in captivity, in slavery. This is 70 AD, and it is letting you know that Rome was persecuting Israel.

“And the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.” The dragon, the white man, stood before the nation of Israel to kill Jesus the Christ. Put it with Matthew 2:13 and it names him: Herod was the one looking to kill Christ, and Herod was an Idumean. Idumea is a word for Edom; the history books know the house of Herod the Idumean. The Most High is telling you right there that the so-called white man is the devil. And it is the same Roman beast, rebirthed into this beast here, doing the exact same thing: killing off your babies. Same mentality.

“She brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.” That man child is Christ, and he was caught up: transfigured, taken up.

“The woman fled into the wilderness.” That is Africa. We fled out of Jerusalem into Africa, the same place where Joseph took Mary and the child Jesus to hide from the evil edict of Herod.

“Where she hath a place prepared of God”: after the wilderness, a place was prepared for us, the Americas, by the slave ships. This place is where we stand right now, Babylon the great, and here we are fed.

“A thousand two hundred and threescore days.” A score is twenty, so threescore is sixty: 1260 days, three and a half years, which stands for 350 years. It is the same time period as the three days and an half of Revelation 11, the forty and two months, and the time, times and dividing of time in Daniel. It all lets you know that we are the Israelites.
“And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon.” When we wake up, Christ is coming back to kill our enemies.

“To the woman were given two wings of a great eagle”: that is our escape, a great escape out of Jerusalem when Rome came against us. It says the same thing as verse 6 in more detail.

“That she might fly into the wilderness”: into Africa, to flee from the Roman persecution and slavery. The brother wrote in his book, From Babylon to Timbuktu, that the Israelites fled from Roman persecution and slavery, that the slave markets were full of black Jewish slaves, and he gave the names of the generals that came behind us, Vespasian and Titus. We were persecuted before Christ even came on the scene, and we were looking for Christ to be born to get this off of us.

“Where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time”: time is one, times is two, and half a time: three and a half again, as in Daniel.

“From the face of the serpent.” Who is feeding us? The serpent: the white man is the devil the Bible speaks of.

precepts.why:
This is the persecution Revelation is speaking of. “The angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.” Herod had sent out an edict to look for Christ and kill him, and they were killing our babies from two years down. These bastards were murdering our children like they seek to do today.

They are called bastards because the Most High said they are not his children. If you be without chastisement, then are ye bastards: a bastard does not have a father. The Lord is not their father. The Lord is your father. These people running this system are not your friends: they want to see us destroyed and in slavery, and that is what this eighth beast is all about.

“Flee into Egypt.” If Jesus was a white boy, how the hell could you hide him in Egypt, a black country? He would have stood out like a sore thumb. He was able to hide among black people because Jesus is black, and his mother and father are black. They have been lying on this Bible all along.

So when Revelation says the woman was “pained to be delivered”, and that the dragon stood before her “for to devour her child as soon as it was born”, it is what we read here: Herod will seek the young child to destroy him. That is the great red dragon, the white man, right there.

This shows why Revelation says “another wonder in heaven”: it means our heaven. “Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.” The Bible said that: nobody was greater than John the Baptist except Christ. He was the forerunner to Christ, and yes, he was in the truth, you dumb stupid ass people with them dumb stupid lies, you dumb negroes in these wicked evil camps. They have demons on them for real.

The subject matter is the kingdom of heaven. “And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.” What is the kingdom of heaven? The Israelites, the twelve tribes of Israel. The kingdom of heaven where the Most High is suffers no violence; the violence was happening to us, in our kingdom.

“The violent take it by force”: that is the great red dragon. The Romans came into our heaven and took our kingdom by force. That is why the disciples asked in Acts whether at this time he would restore the kingdom to Israel: Rome had taken it. And that is why Revelation 12 speaks of the woman crying to be delivered, and of a wonder in heaven.

This shows why the eighth head was not there yet when the dragon of Revelation 12 had seven heads. “I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death”: that is Rome. Rome was overthrown in 193 AD by black Jews, the Israelites, and that brought on what they call the Dark Ages.

“And his deadly wound was healed.” The Roman head was healed in the Renaissance; that is what renaissance means, rebirth. When they came back they ran a campaign of iconoclasm to destroy all the black images we had painted all over Europe. Then the so-called Spaniards came and took our brothers of the northern and southern kingdoms, and started the slave trade.

That is when the eighth head started to bud, building itself up from the 1500s up to 1776. They were already causing trouble for Gad and Reuben under the thirteen colonies, but when they established America in their so-called independence, they broke away completely from the seventh head, Great Britain, and that is when the eighth head came into rulership. It is the one that goes into perdition, because the Israelites are here and the Lord is going to burn this place up with fire and brimstone for what they did to us.

“And all the world wondered after the beast”: all the world wondered after America. All the world gave this thing its power, its honor and its pledge, and worshiped it.

This is the casting of the stars to the earth: the Israelites cast into captivity. “When ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies”: the Roman armies, what we read in Revelation 12. “Then know that the desolation thereof is nigh”: it was prophesied that Jerusalem would be destroyed.

“Then let them which are in Judea flee to the mountains.” That is what we did: a whole lot of us fled into Egypt, into Africa, the same place Joseph took Jesus and his mother. “Let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto”: the other tribes were already gone from Jerusalem, already over here. That is the twelve tribes scattered abroad that James writes to.

“For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.” It was time for us to get that judgment for breaking the laws, all the way back from the time of Moses.

“Woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.” From Babylon to Timbuktu records the outrageous atrocities levied against our people then: the Romans chopped up our babies and the women that were with child. And the wrath was from the Most High upon us.

“They shall fall by the edge of the sword”: the sword of the Romans. They are going to pay for this: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Even though we messed up with the Lord, they will still pay for what they did to us.

“And shall be led away captive into all nations.” Everywhere we have gone, we have been the sweat equity of all the nations. The world economy was built off the destruction of our babies, our mothers and fathers, and the whole earth is rejoicing over the fact that we are destroyed.

“And Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles”: the bastards in Ashdod, Tel Aviv. Jerusalem has white people on it calling themselves us, but the Lord called them the Gentiles. They are not the Jews. “Until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled”: until their time is up, and their ass is going to the 149th Psalm: slavery.

This shows what the place prepared of God is. “Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered.” After the wilderness, we came to this place.

“In the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people”: that is where they destroyed our nationality. In the place where it was said you are not the Israelites, they called us everything: undocumented workers, wetbacks, all kinds of evil things. And when we pick up the Bible to get our nationality back, they hit us with a trumped up charge and call us anti-Semitic, because they promoted a set of bastard people as the Jews. That is why the nations confederate so that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance: they do not want us to know we are the Israelites.

“There it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.” In that same place, this beast here, Babylon the great, where you were called every evil name, you are learning that you are the Israelites, the children of the living God. That means they cannot stop this gospel.

“Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head”: that head is Christ. “And they shall come up out of the land”: that is when we go home. And those rats that are in our land are going to be destroyed and blown the hell out of there, for the branches within the land shall shoot forth, for my people Israel is coming home.

This is the same time period as the 1260 days, and the same place. “Their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt.” This is the number one place for sodomy, homosexual heaven and lesbian utopia; it is not the actual Sodom, but no place on earth has more sodomy in it than right here. And it mimics Egypt, where the twelve tribes were in bondage and slavery: the Lord said he would bring us into bondage again with ships, and that happened here. It has both traits, so it is crystal clear what place we are in.

We are dead to who we are. Once they said you are not the children of Israel, you are not my people, we became dead. Run around calling yourself a negro talking about some Fourth of July and end up dead for real. Our people think they are with friends, go off with these people, and their ass ends up dead because nobody taught them better. You think you are in America with your bicentennial red, white and blue all over your brain, and you do not recognize that you and your children are in the land of your enemies. You better recognize that fast.

“Where also our Lord was crucified.” Christ was not crucified over here physically, but they gave us Christianity and destroyed the minds of our people completely.

“They of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half”: mentally and spiritually dead, a wasted people in this captivity, for 350 years. That correlates with the 1260 days, the forty and two months, and the time, times and dividing of time in Daniel. “And shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves”: we are not physically dead; we are dead in our brains, dead in Christianity, in philosophy, in these dumb stupid holidays.

“They that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another.” The nations are rejoicing over our destroyed minds, having a good time celebrating our destruction. And what is better than to have a negro with you partying? He is the life of the party and does not even recognize it. Their prosperity and their enjoyment are because his ass is destroyed; they have all this liberty because your family, your people, your nation is destroyed. Then they kill you behind it and laugh about it. “Because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth”: they know our history even when we do not. They remember the power we once ruled with, and know that when we rule we will set everything straight; go back into the history and see how we tore their behinds up when we were ruling. Our brothers back then knew the history. Today we do not know a damn thing, sitting up in church blind. The damn mice in the church know more than our people sitting up in there.

“After three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them”: after 350 years, the dry bones of Ezekiel 37 coming to life. That is you waking up to the truth, the sons of the living God of Hosea. “And they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them”, because they know that our God is coming back to kick their ass. When the Lord comes with them chariots tearing their behinds up, they cannot do a damn thing with them angels.

This shows who it is that feeds the woman “from the face of the serpent”, and why. It goes with Luke: “these be the days of vengeance”, because we broke the commandments of the Lord.

“Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart.” We are not happy to keep the Most High’s holy days. We show joyfulness and gladness of heart for the Fourth of July and these pagan, wicked holidays, but when it comes to the Passover, the Sabbath, the Day of Atonement, the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the beautiful holidays the Lord gave us, you have your damn lips stuck out. You are mad. But when it comes to these wicked ass holidays, you go celebrate that and end up dead.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee.” God did that, because we would not keep his laws with gladness. “In hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”: for food, for water, for clothing, for hospital care, for anything we need, we have to go to the enemy, the devil the Bible just told us of in Revelation. Even the textiles they stole; we own nothing. You have Esau bragging about it now, and they do not realize they are going to pay for all of that. God set it up that way because we made our Father mad.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Who put the yoke of iron on our neck? The white man. You can just say it: the so-called white man. He is the devil, the serpent the Bible is talking about in Revelation, and this same serpent put a chain around your neck. Until we are dead bodies in the street of America, not even knowing who the hell we are. Until he has destroyed your mind and you do not know which way is up, talking about some Fourth of July when your behind was in slavery on that same damn date. Dumb as hell.

And because of your evil ass preachers: the Most High is going to make their ass pay too for deceiving you. Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of his pasture: taking his Bible and lying to God’s people with it is a serious crime.

sense.text:
“And the beast that was”: the beast in John’s vision. John was marveling at this scarlet beast that carried the woman, and he wanted to know about this eighth head. “And is not”: it was not there in John’s time.

“Even he is the eighth, and is of the seven.” The eighth head was supported by the seven heads; the seven carried it and gave birth to it. It is the materialization of the seven, a compilation of them, a super demon on this earth, and we are in the midst of it. It is America, Babylon the great.

“And goeth into perdition.” This place is about to be destroyed by God. The Lord is going to make this whole beast burn because the Israelites are here, because of what it did to us.

The mindset and psychology of this eighth head is to enslave our children for sweat equity. You were not brought over here to enjoy the prosperity of this place; it was stolen from your brothers Gad and Reuben, and they need us to be the sweat equity so they can have a great time. That is why they are acting up now, talking about DEI as if we are the real recipients of it. They are the complete robbers of the whole planet earth, but they make us seem like we are the problem. These people are demonic; they do not give a damn whether the evidence is there or not. Their philosophy is might makes right: they have the power to legitimize their criminality. They murdered, raped, robbed and stole the land from our brothers, the Native American Indians, then set up courts and told us to come learn justice, and set churches on top of blood and bones and said come learn about Jesus.

So watch over and guide your children. Go to school and do well on your jobs, but use all of it for the benefit of your nation, so that we are found in favor in God’s eyesight when he comes to redeem us. As long as your mind thinks Babylon has a place for you, you are sadly mistaken.

This is the land the Jewish Encyclopedia calls Arsareth: the land beyond the great river, far from the habitation of man, where the ten tribes of Israel would dwell observing the laws of Moses until the time of the restoration, and it says Columbus identified America with this land. It cites fourth Ezra, which is 2 Esdras. Four books belong to the same Ezra: Ezra, Nehemiah as the second, 1 Esdras as the third, and 2 Esdras as the fourth.

“Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land.” Salmanasar, the king of Assyria, came in and took the northern kingdom into captivity, “and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land”: into Assyria.

“But they took this counsel among themselves.” That counsel was taken in the time of Persia. It goes from Assyria straight to Cyrus: the northern tribes decided not to follow the decree written in Ezra to go and build in Jerusalem.

“That they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt”: that is the Americas, Arsareth, which Columbus called America. Columbus was looking for the tribes to pillage the nation of Israel: the prophet Ezra gave him the idea of how far the tribes were, and he got that knowledge from records gathered back in the time of the Greeks, when Alexander collected the records of everybody, because he understood the Bible was the book to have.

“That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land.” That is what James Adair recorded among the North American Indians, raising up seed to their brethren, and why he concluded they were descended from the lost tribes.

“And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow places of the river.” The map of the route shows the journey beginning at the Euphrates and coming down into the ocean, around Africa, and across: Naphtali, Asher, then the islands, Ephraim, Simeon, Manasseh, Zebulun where the haven of ships is, the Panama Canal, and up into the United States where Gad and Reuben are. These lying devils did not want you to know any of this history.

“For the most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over.” The Most High was with us. He showed them signs: they were able to read the stars, and that is how they were the navigators.

“Through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half.” They had to make stops along the way at the ports of the maritime period. We were used to that, because Solomon’s navy had already sailed those routes.

“And the same region is called Arsareth”: the region Columbus knew about, which he called America.

That is why the book They Came Before Columbus matters: the African presence in ancient America, and far more to black history than the slave trade. The ships were ours: East African trading ships that sailed the Indian Ocean between Africa and China, seafaring before Columbus in the Lesser Antilles, papyrus boats built on the ancient pattern that rode the currents from Africa to America. Issachar understood those currents. And the Olmec heads, with the lips, the nose, the features of our people, and the figures called Semitic: these were the Israelites who came on the ships in the time we read of here, before that devil was even thought of over here.
“Then dwelt they there until the latter time.” They dwelt here in the Americas until the latter times, and that is why we are here in the latter times.

precepts.why:
This shows how the Most High “shewed signs for them”: they could read the stars. “Of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do.” Issachar understood the times, so they were able to lead the ships as they came over: they knew how to navigate the waters and the currents.

“The heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.” So everybody sees we are not playing games: the tribes that crossed to Arsareth had the navigators among them.

sense.text:
They say they discovered this land: a bunch of dead bastards, demons. Some people might not like the choice of words, but the word bastard is in the Bible, and it is all in the spirit. “And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod.” There it is in the Bible, spelled out. So put a bar in your mouth the next time you want to speak against it, and shut the hell up.

Ashdod is the seaport city the Philistines used to occupy: modern-day Tel Aviv. So the bastard dwelling in Ashdod is the people in our land now, calling themselves the Jews.

The six-pointed symbol shows up on some of the pre-Columbian figures, and some camps run with it thinking it is a symbol of the Lord. It is not. What they call the star of Molech stems from Solomon’s idolatry, and this shows where it came from, so that you are not ignorant.

“But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites.” Solomon committed a great sin when he did this.

“Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods.” These women would surely turn Solomon’s mind around. That is why we are not supposed to deal with the other nations: they will turn your mind around. It did not say maybe, or that they might. It said surely.

“Solomon clave unto these in love”: he was celebrating with them and building temples to their gods.
“He had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines”: that was a lot to drive him crazy. “And his wives turned away his heart.”

“When Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as was the heart of David his father.” That is where that star came in, Remphan, Molech, all of that madness. And because he was into it, his navy was involved in it, which is why you see those symbols in some of the records. But it is not a symbol we are supposed to deal with.

David did not go off like that. David had his situation with Bathsheba, but that was it, and his whole house paid for it.

“Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians.” Ashtoreth is where the word Easter comes from: the goddess of fertility. Solomon was into that because of these damn women, “and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.”

“And Solomon did evil in the sight of the Lord.” When that symbol, that mysticism and all that madness came in, Solomon was into pure evil, and “went not fully after the Lord, as did David his father.”

“Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.” That is the witchcraft we ended up following. “And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.” Solomon did wickedness here and sinned greatly because of it.

“And the Lord was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the Lord God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice.” But this is about repentance too: whether Solomon repented is answered in Ecclesiastes.

They say God gave David the hexagram and called it the Star of David. It is no star. That is like trying to squeeze a square peg into a circle: they search the Bible for every scripture with the word shield or seal and try to make it say it is the star. The mind of a negro says, I will not be proven wrong. That is a damn lie that is going to get your behinds killed; it is witchcraft.

The Song of Solomon is a metaphor: the whole book represents the Lord’s relationship with his chosen people, Israel. “Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.”

The heart is the mind. So what was Solomon, in his righteousness, saying to set as a seal upon the mind and upon the arm? Not a six-point hexagram. The seal is the law, the words of God.

So stop following the so-called white man and his lies, and come on one accord.

precepts.why:
This is what Solomon was referring to. “Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul”: these words are the laws of God, laid up in the heart, which is the mind.

“And bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.” In ancient times Israel wore the laws on leather wrapped around their arms, and as frontlets on the forehead.

So “set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm” is the law: on the mind and on the arm, exactly as the Lord commanded here.

Ezra lists the destruction of Israel: “our sanctuary is laid waste, our altar broken down, our temple destroyed; Our psaltery is laid on the ground, our song is put to silence, our rejoicing is at an end, the light of our candlestick is put out”, the menorah put out, “the ark of our covenant is spoiled, our holy things are defiled, and the name that is called upon us is almost profaned”, the name Israel. Our priests burnt, our Levites in captivity, our virgins defiled, our wives ravished, our young men in bondage, our strong men weak.

“And, which is the greatest of all, the seal of Sion hath now lost her honour.” What is the seal of Sion? Is it talking about the six-point hexagram, the star of Remphan, the star of Molech? No. The seal of Sion is the law, as Isaiah shows.

This settles what the seal of Sion is. “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” The law is the seal. The law is the seal.

So when Solomon says “Set me as a seal upon thine heart”, and Ezra mourns that “the seal of Sion hath now lost her honour”, it is the law of God, not a star.

“And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” Then the verse before: “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.”

What is the seal in their foreheads? Some of you right now are going, yeah, the star of David. You are simple as hell. Go right back to Isaiah 8:16: “seal the law among my disciples.” The seal we must be sealed with is the law, the frontlets between the eyes of Deuteronomy. There is nothing else to be said about it; anything else is your own vain opinion.

sense.text:
Did Solomon repent? Some say it is a debate. Just like many of us that go off, Solomon could repent, and you can repent. Get yourselves right, brothers and sisters.

“Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.” This is what Solomon realized.

“Because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge”: he came out of that foolishness and taught the people properly. “And set in order many proverbs”: the Proverbs we read, Solomon wrote those.
“The preacher sought to find out acceptable words”: he sought out the wisdom of the Most High. He said the hell with all this other mess, I need to get myself right.

He had asked to know all kinds of evil and explored everything; once he found it all out, he realized the truth is right here with the Most High.

“The words of the wise are as goads”: a goad is the stick a shepherd uses to drive the sheep and keep them from straying. “And as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies”: Christ is the master of assemblies. “Which are given from one shepherd”: Christ is the shepherd. This is Solomon coming to recognize this.

“And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end.” After all he dealt with, Solomon says the books and all the gods and philosophies are out here everywhere, up and down, backwards and forwards, and some of us are getting caught up in that evil. Recognize where your true power is.

“And much study is a weariness of the flesh”: studying all these gods and philosophies is a waste of time. All you get out of it is tired; it profits you nothing but death.

“Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter”: when it is all said and done, this is what you need to do. So that star of Remphan, that star of Molech, is not biblical. If you see it in archaeology records, understand where it came from; Solomon went through that and had to repent of it.

“Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.” That is the bottom line, the whole reason God put you on this earth. God said have no other gods before me. Celebrating the Fourth of July is putting gods before the Most High, and that is the reason why your behind ends up dead.

“For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.” Solomon understood that. He was done with all of it; thank the Lord he was able to repent, get himself back right, and deal with his people properly.

The book Lost Tribes and Promised Lands tells of Antonio de Montezinos, who in 1644 came to Amsterdam from South America. His Indian guides had told him the natives of that country deserved all they suffered at the hands of the Spaniards because they had so badly treated a holy people, the greatest in the world: they were speaking of how they treated Gad and Reuben. And the guide Francisco said his countrymen would be avenged on the Spaniards by a people now hidden.

Montezinos pretended to be their brother, and Francisco brought him to a river. A canoe came over with three men and a woman, Indians as they say, and they said to him: Shema Israel, Adonai Eloheinu, Adonai Echad. Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

That is in the Bible. “The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord.” What in the world would an Indian be doing saying this? They recited in Hebrew the first of the commandments, and they told him they were of the tribe of Reuben, and that the tribe of Joseph lived on an island nearby: Ephraim is Puerto Rico and Manasseh is Cuba, the two tribes of Joseph.

And Francisco’s own people knew it from their traditions: the God of these children of Israel is the true God, everything on their tablets is true, and at the end of days they will be lords of all the nations. One nation will come bringing many things to this land, and after we have all been provided for, these children of Israel will go forth from where they are and reign over the whole earth as they once did. Notice it does not call them Indians. That is the time of restoration.

These records come from the Spanish explorers of the southern United States, catalogued in the Library of Congress. They know who we are; they keep the records and hide them among themselves, knowing our people are not taught any of it.
